profiles.title: Your profiles
profiles.help: Keep either one up to date; both can live side by side.
profiles.helpNone: Add a business profile, a work profile, or both. One is enough to post and send requests.
profiles.requiredHelp: To post or send a request, Vyapar needs to know who you are. Add a business profile or a work profile — either one is enough.
profiles.businessDesc: A shop, firm or service business people can find and contact.
profiles.professionalDesc: You and your skills, so people who hire can find you.
profiles.workSectionHint: What people who hire see: your skills, area and how you work.
profiles.businessSectionHint: Optional. Add it if you run a shop, firm or service business.
